# SLAB: new home permits, Austin TX

> Weekly list of every new house that got a building permit in Austin, Texas (2,274 in the last 12 months), for companies that sell to new homeowners. Built from City of Austin open data (Issued Construction Permits, 3syk-w9eu), deduplicated and mapped. Each record: street address, ZIP, square footage, builder, permit date, estimated move-in month (permit + 7 months). Prices: $49/month for chosen ZIP codes, delivered Fridays; $750 one-time Territory Report (12 months of one service area). Published by Commonfield Labs.

Public pages show street and ZIP only; full addresses go to subscribers. No homeowner names, phone numbers or emails are included.

## Start here
- [What subscribers get](https://slabpermits.com/what-you-get.html): the offer, sample rows, pricing and FAQ
- [New homeowner leads in Austin](https://slabpermits.com/new-homeowner-leads-austin.html): who uses it and why permits beat new mover lists
- [Latest weekly issue](https://slabpermits.com/): this week's new homes, mapped
- [12 months of new construction permits](https://slabpermits.com/austin-new-construction-permits.html): monthly totals, busiest ZIPs, top builders
